trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to Litlyx
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Litlyx
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: The binding terms reserve the right to modify or discontinue any part of the service with or without notice, which materially limits a promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any part of the service with or without notice.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be modified or discontinued at any time under the terms.

exhibits.quote: Post-cancellation, your stats are inaccessible and eventually permanently deleted from backups after 60 days.
exhibits.argument: Access and stored data are not permanent and are deleted after cancellation.

trials.claim: Litlyx supports tracking unlimited domains within a single account
trials.claimQuote: Litlyx supports tracking unlimited domains within a single account, allowing you to manage and filter analytics data across different websites or projects from one dashboard.
trials.reasoning: Deal buyers consistently report codes are limited per website and to only 1 project, contradicting unlimited domains in a single account despite generic vendor statements.

exhibits.quote: the codes can only be used PER website that you have. I think that's way too limiting.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports codes are limited per website rather than unlimited domains.

exhibits.quote: With only 1 project this is not usefull for agencies
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being limited to only one project, contradicting unlimited domain management.

exhibits.quote: Yes. Consolidate projects and filter across domains from a single account.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms multiple domains can be consolidated and filtered from a single account.

exhibits.quote: Yes! Your plan applies at the account level, covering all workspaces and the domains within them.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms the plan covers all workspaces and domains at the account level.

trials.claimQuote: The simplest all-in-one analytics platform for your website or web apps that you’ll ever need. GDPR-ready ✅
